grains.RAW.SUPPLIERS: one row per supplier (planning area x product category)
grains.RAW.SUPPLIER_DAILY: one row per supplier per day (90 days)
grains.RAW.SKU_SOURCING: one row per supplier (SKU sourcing snapshot)

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day network-wide inbound shipment FORECAST; ASN quantity variance ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.DELIVERY_SOP_SEARCH over synthetic delivery-exception follow-up SOPs (one per product category and exception signal)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.SUPPLY_CHAIN_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.SUPPLY_CHAIN_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; the action memo uses only KPI, supplier, exception-signal and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (suppliers, daily inbound shipments, confirmed delivery misses by supplier, delivery-miss risk, shipment events loaded) over an existing Snowflake data source
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: Amazon Data Firehose (Direct PUT) of supplier inbound-shipment events -> S3 (shipments/) -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_SHIPMENTS
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_SHIPMENT_ALERT logs new FLAG events to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)
required_capabilities.delivery_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(confirmed delivery miss in next 7 days) per supplier, evaluated on an out-of-time holdout
